text: appaṭividitasuttaṃ [15] ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi yesaṃ dhammā appaṭividitā 1 paravādesu nīyare 2 suttā te nappabujjhanti kālo tesaṃ pabujjhitunti . [16] yesaṃ dhammā supaṭividitā paravādesu na nīyare sambuddhā sammadaññāya 3 caranti visame samanti . aṭṭhamaṃ
